200
Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management successfully updated the specified cloud connector.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
string
The UUID of the connector that was updated.
— 400
Returned if your request specified invalid parameters or if your request was improperly formatted.
connector_id
required
connector
id
— 403 Returned if you do not have permission to update cloud connectors.
— 404 Returned if the specified connector doesn't exist.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
